title: Entry Criteria of the Corporate Travel Programme Tiers
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes publishes three entry criteria: the traveller seat count at or above which the tier is entered, the annual booking value at or above which it is entered, and whether the tier is entered by tender.

| Programme tier | Seats at least | Annual booking value at least (USD) | Entered by tender |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 1 | 0 | No |
| Business Team Programme | 5 | 50000 | No |
| Business Pro Programme | 20 | 250000 | No |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 75 | 1000000 | No |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 250 | 4000000 | Yes |
| Business Global Programme | 750 | 12000000 | Yes |

Both quantitative criteria are stated as floors, so a company sitting exactly on a published figure sits at or above it. Tender is published for the two largest tiers only; the four below them are entered without one.
